placements.title: Automated Content Slug Derivation and Fallbacks Ensure Ingestion Persistence Without Explicit IDs
placements.frame: How does the pipeline guarantee reliable identifier derivation and file commitment when submissions omit explicit ID fields?
placements.why: src-1 introduces the condition of a memory submission omitting an explicit id, and src-2 defines the operational requirement for the pipeline to reliably derive a slug via LLM generation or deterministic fallback to successfully commit the file.
